rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE MASSIVE PRODUCTION OF MINERALS FOR EXPORT TO SPEED UP THE ECONOMIC RECOVERY OF THE COUNTRY
rows.abstract: Directs  the Department of Environment and Natural Resources to develop a mining program; delegates  the Bureau  of Mines  to manage  the mining operations and tasks the Department  of Trade   and Industry  to market   the mineral products. Aims  togain fast and added income  to the country by developing the following mines: gold, chromite, copper, silver, nickel, manganese, zinc,  cement, sand and gravel, marble,  white clay, coal, guano, adobe, limestone, perlite  and phosphate rock. * * *
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 1992-08-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO HELP POOR STUDENTS PURSUE THEIR EDUCATION BY ENCOURAGING THEIR EMPLOYMENT DURING SUMMER AND/OR CHRISTMAS VACATIONS, THROUGH INCENTIVES GRANTED TO EMPLOYERS, PROHIBITING AND PENALIZING THE FILING OF FRAUDULENT OR FICTITIOUS CLAIMS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Provides for the employment of students, ages 15 to 25, during summer or Christmas break. Directs the Secretaries of the Departments of Labor  and Employment, of Education, Culture  and Sports,  and of Finance to prescribe  the rules implementing this Act.   * * *
